title: pneumonanthe fischeri
intro: Pneumonanthe fischeri, commonly known as Lungwort, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional European folk medicine. The health benefits of Lungwort include its ability to stimulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, which may help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Lungwort include gentianine, gentiopicrin, and amarogentin, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties.
